articles.desc: Millionen Vögel sterben Schätzungen zufolge jedes Jahr in Berlin an Glasfassaden. Der Senat zeigt Bauherren nun, wie Vogelschlag an Fenstern verhindert werden kann. articles.title: Toward standardized microplastics monitoring in rivers
articles.desc: Microplastics (MPs), defined as plastic fragments smaller than 5 mm, have become so pervasive that they are detectable in nearly every environment studied—from remote ocean trenches to urban air, tap water, and human blood. articles.title: Achiral crystal reveals Raman optical activity through ferroaxial order
articles.desc: Raman optical activity, long thought to require chiral molecules or magnetic order, has been demonstrated in an achiral, nonmagnetic crystal by researchers at the Institute of Science Tokyo.
